reason_for_amendment: The frozen Gaussian input matrices were inspected before the formal seed matrix. At the eight-field budget their whitened condition numbers were 30.6717, 2646.8682, and 15.5896. Field count therefore failed to control directional coverage and would confound the saturation curve with random experimental-design conditioning.

learning_results_seen_before_amendment.use_in_amended_claim: The capacity result remains a capability control. The Gaussian target results are exploratory and excluded from the amended saturation verdict.

amended_target_design.construction: For each seed, draw one 8 by 8 standard-Gaussian matrix, take a QR factorization, canonicalize column signs, and use sqrt(8) times the first n rows of the orthogonal factor at budget n.
amended_target_design.whitened_nonzero_singular_values: All equal to sqrt(8) at every budget.
amended_target_design.scientific_purpose: Vary only the dimension of target excitation coverage while holding drive energy and conditioning fixed.

unchanged_instrument_and_gates.capacity: At most 0.5% direct-operator relative response error.
unchanged_instrument_and_gates.target_threshold: Eight-field geometric-mean target-only error at most 1.5%.
unchanged_instrument_and_gates.one_field_not_saturated: One-field geometric-mean target-only error at least 2.5%.
unchanged_instrument_and_gates.material_improvement: Four-field error at most 80% and eight-field error at most 50% of one-field error.
unchanged_instrument_and_gates.monotonicity: Geometric-mean error strictly decreases at every budget.

decision_rule: Only the orthogonal-design seed matrix may decide the saturation gate. Gaussian pilot results remain an explicit invalid-design record.
scope: Designed orthogonal drives test label efficiency under active experimental design. Passive random-drive efficiency is a separate question and is not inferred.
